title: Bootstrap Inference for the Finite Population Mean under Complex Sampling Designs
one_line_what_it_does: Generates bootstrap finite populations (multinomial), replays the actual design (stratified multistage cluster, Poisson, SRS, PPS-WR) on each, uses studentization; proves second-order accuracy by Edgeworth expansion
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Pseudo-population + design replay + studentized quantiles replacing normal/t: the generic mechanism of the claim; not PPI/GREG, pseudo-population built from sample only, asymptotic n

title: Bootstrap Methods for Finite Populations
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap by constructing pseudo-population from sample replicated N/n times then SRSWOR from it; bootstrap-t second-order
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Finite-population pseudo-population bootstrap-t (SRS); no auxiliary known for all units, no clusters

title: A survey of bootstrap methods in finite population sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Review: pseudo-population, direct and weights bootstraps; PPB algorithms incl. unequal-probability, two-stage; bootstrap-t intervals; GREG with auxiliary rescaled
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Defines the pseudo-population family the claim re-invents; auxiliary variables enter only via sample pairs

title: Bootstrapping the Chambers-Dunstan estimate of a finite population distribution function
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap population built as fitted superpopulation regression on covariate known for ALL units + resampled smoothed recentred residuals; consistency proven; CI from bootstrap quantiles
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Exactly 'pseudo-population z~ = a^+b^f+e~ with residuals resampled or smoothed' with covariate known for whole population; then design replay; unit-level, not few clusters, not PPI

title: Bootstrapping the Dorfman-Hall-Chambers-Dunstan estimator of a finite population distribution function
one_line_what_it_does: Nonparametric-regression version; bootstrap population from recentred residuals of superpopulation model; bias/variance/distribution of prediction error
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: As above (smoothed residual pseudo-population)

title: A random effect block bootstrap for clustered data
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap populations for clustered data from marginal residuals/predicted random effects, free of distributional assumptions
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster-level residual pseudo-population with regression on known covariates (SAE MSE); not design-replay under rejective designs

title: Gaussian Prepivoting for Finite Population Causal Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Imputes missing potential outcomes then enumerates/simulates the exact randomization distribution of studentized/prepivoted statistic under the ACTUAL design incl. rerandomization (Mahalanobis); regression-adjusted estimators
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-exact reference distribution of studentized statistic on imputed population under rerandomized (=rejective) designs; closest conceptual analogue to claim in causal setting

title: A Causal Bootstrap
one_line_what_it_does: Imputes missing potential outcomes via copula then resamples assignment under design; bootstrap of t-statistic
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Impute-then-redraw-design logic; assignment not cluster selection

title: Prepivoting to reduce level error of confidence sets
one_line_what_it_does: Prepivoting / double bootstrap calibration of roots
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Source of 'double-bootstrap calibration' part of claim

title: Fuller, Legg, Li: Bootstrap Variance Estimation for Rejective Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap variance estimation specific to rejective sampling
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Bears on rejective-design replay; variance only, no pseudo-population from predictions

title: Improved variance estimation for balanced samples drawn via the Cube method
one_line_what_it_does: Simulation-based second-order inclusion probabilities for cube samples
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cube design replay by simulation (already known prior art)

title: A Note on the Prediction-Powered Bootstrap
one_line_what_it_does: PPBoot: percentile bootstrap resampling labeled and unlabeled data to form PPI intervals
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Bootstrap of PPI but resamples observed data (no pseudo-population, no design)

title: Prediction-Powered Inference with Imputed Covariates and Nonuniform Sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Predict-then-debias bootstrap incl. cluster sampling: resample clusters with replacement (Algorithm 5)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cluster bootstrap for PPI; pairs cluster resampling, known to fail at few clusters

title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Closed-form cluster-robust SE for PPI++, partially labeled clusters; notes undercoverage with few labeled clusters (88% at small n)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Documents the few-cluster failure the claim targets; offers no corrected reference distribution

title: PPI is the Difference Estimator
one_line_what_it_does: PPI = difference estimator, PPI++ = GREG; contrasts design-based vs model-based variance (SRSWOR)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Establishes survey-sampling equivalence; no pseudo-population reference distribution

title: Design-Based Prediction-Powered Inference for Spatial Data
one_line_what_it_does: Design-based PPI, exact design variances, enumerated-population check
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-based PPI; no pseudo-population reference distribution

title: Cameron, Gelbach, Miller: Bootstrap-based improvements for inference with clustered errors
one_line_what_it_does: Cluster bootstrap-t / wild bootstrap with 5-30 clusters; enumeration of 2^G
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Econometrics few-cluster reference distribution; pairs bootstrap-t fails at G=6 (rejection 0.005 in cited MC)

title: MacKinnon & Webb: Wild bootstrap randomization inference for few treated clusters
one_line_what_it_does: RI and wild-bootstrap alternatives with few clusters
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Few-cluster reference distribution (treatment-assignment RI), not sampling-design

title: Noninformative Bayesian approach to finite population sampling using auxiliary variables (Polya posterior)
one_line_what_it_does: Simulate completed populations from Polya posterior constrained by known auxiliary information, then compute interval
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Simulated-population inference with known auxiliaries; no design replay

title: Design-based conformal prediction
one_line_what_it_does: Conformal prediction intervals under survey designs
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-based, different target (prediction sets)

title: Propensity Score Propagation
one_line_what_it_does: Regenerates plausible design probabilities, unions design-based intervals
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-based interval w/ uncertainty regeneration; different nuisance

title: Statistical inference on representational geometries
one_line_what_it_does: Subject-level bootstrap underestimates variance with very few subjects
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Neuroscience analogue of few-cluster bootstrap failure
